additional_info.subject: RE: ID0396847-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / S2 170003140] The outlets are not available CRM:00641000898
additional_info.body:
Hi Sebastien/Team,
We have analyzed the logs and Found that the FW version of LOGO is v4.0.0
and Charger FW is
v4.0.11
And Charger is 300kW.
So, We recommend to plan a site intervention.
We need to downgrade the FW version of LOGO to v2.7.0
You can download the file from
LOGO! FW V2.7 for SICHARGE D - ID: 109821347 - Industry Support Siemens
Follow the LOGO update procedure from
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_SICD_SW_LOGO_ LOGO update process - Dynamics 365
In addition to this, We recommend charger to be on latest FW v6.0.3.
Since, Charger is on FW v4.0.11, We recommend to first update it to v5.0.23 and then to v6.0.3
Also, Have couple of charging sessions to validate if issue persists.
Hope it will solve the issue.
If you still face issue feel free to reach out to us.
Do let us know if you have any other query.
Thank and Best Regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Giridhar "Gary"
